theory.overview: Advanced DP techniques build on fundamentals to solve complex optimization problems. Key patterns include: State Machine DP (multiple states with transitions), Digit DP (counting numbers with digit constraints), DP on Trees (post-order traversal for tree structures), and DP with Bitmasking (for small sets represented as bitmasks). State space optimization reduces memory from O(n²) to O(n) when only previous state is needed.

keyConcepts.name: State Machine DP
keyConcepts.description: Multiple states with transitions between them. Example: stock trading with states (hold, not hold, cooldown).

keyConcepts.name: Digit DP
keyConcepts.description: Count numbers in range satisfying digit constraints using memoization on (position, tight, leadingZero, sum).

keyConcepts.name: Tree DP
keyConcepts.description: Process tree bottom-up. DP[u] depends on DP[v] for all children v of u. Post-order traversal.

keyConcepts.name: Bitmask DP
keyConcepts.description: Represent subsets as bitmasks (integers). DP[mask] stores optimal solution for elements in mask.

algorithmSteps.description: State Machine: rest (no stock), hold (have stock), sold (just sold).
Day 1: rest=0 (do nothing), hold=-price[0] (buy), sold=0 (can't sell).
Day 2: rest=max(0,0)=0, hold=max(-5,-1)=-1, sold=0+4=4? Adjust based on prices.
Space optimization: Only need previous day's 3 states. O(1) space!
Result: max of final states. Achieved optimal trading strategy.
